blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Understanding human needs and selecting responses require distinct judgments that aggregate accuracy can obscure. We introduce PsycheMME, a video benchmark informed by psychology, with eight capabilities spanning grounding, states, needs, interaction decisions, memory, and risk. Drawing on Social Information Processing and the Perception-Action Cycle, this organization separates human understanding from response selection. We construct 1,000 questions from 630 episodes through independent answering with proposed references withheld and expert review. Our Reasoning-Verified protocol weights answer credit by the support and logical consistency of explicit rationales against annotated cues. Across 17 models, Timing has the lowest Verified scores and credit retention, with weaker support judgments for correct Timing answers. Models with similar Need scores still differ in answer completeness on open questions. Input controls and SFT/GRPO examine context dependence and adaptation. Evaluating answers alongside rationales locates where models fail across understanding, response selection, and justification.

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Multimodal Foundation Models have expanded from image and text
understanding to video and audio [ 1 , 65 ] .
Their evaluation spans video understanding and increasingly
examines people in egocentric and social settings [ 27 , 39 , 15 , 37 , 7 ] .
Here, recognizing actions is not enough: models must
interpret social cues, infer psychological states and needs,
and make interaction judgments appropriate to the context [ 40 , 50 ] .
Inferring latent states from observable cues is a central problem in
social cognition [ 49 ] . We ask: Can multimodal foundation models understand human
states and needs from observable cues and make
appropriate interaction judgments?

Aggregate accuracy leaves two diagnostic questions unanswered:
where do models struggle between social observation and response selection,
and when do they select the right option without adequate cue support?

Evaluation must assess state inference alongside timing, language,
and action choices, with memory and boundaries as context.

Challenge 2: Psychological constructs and observable cues (Section 3.3 ).
Mental states and support needs are latent. Questions must anchor

coverage, Evidence Support, and Logical Integrity,

blocks.en:
Multimodal Foundation Models extend learning from images and

Magma further connects multimodal understanding to action [ 66 ] .
Beyond scene perception, PersonaVLM explores personalized memory,

blocks.en:

blocks.en:

These perspectives inform PsycheMME’s task definitions;
its rubric for cue support and logic links answer credit to
contextually supported explanations.

explicit criteria [ 74 , 36 ] .

blocks.en:
The question construction framework in Fig. 3 combines
question generation, independent answering, verification, and refinement.
Separating question proposal from independent answering reduces the
risk of accepting a proposal based on its own justification.
The Question Agent proposes a question, candidate
answer, options where applicable, and supporting cues.
The Answer Agent examines the video again using only
the question, options, and public context, without access to the
proposed answer, cues, or private rationale. It independently answers
or flags ambiguity and insufficient support.
The Critic Agent checks both paths for answerability, cue
support, and logical coherence. Proposal defects return to the
Question Agent; reasoning defects trigger another examination. Psychology Knowledge guides the agents’ construct alignment and
inference boundaries; items failing after two refinement rounds are discarded.
A Shared State with access control based on agent roles enforces
information isolation and tracks verification feedback, refinement
history, and taxonomy coverage to guide generation toward
underrepresented capabilities (Appendix C.2 ).

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en:
PsycheMME unifies eight capabilities informed by psychology in a
benchmark of 1,000 questions grounded in video. Its evaluation protocol assesses
answers alongside support from reference cues and the logical integrity
of explicit rationales. Across 17 models, Timing remains difficult,
similar Need scores accompany differences in answer completeness, and voting
can override correct minority answers. Input and history controls
reveal contextual dependence.
These findings describe behavior by capability and justification
quality beyond aggregate accuracy.
The resulting diagnostics support comparisons of human understanding and
interaction judgments while exposing how answer completeness and rationale
support shape reported performance.
The benchmark can guide future improvements in answer completeness,
temporal grounding, and response selection informed by context.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
PsycheMME evaluates human-centered reasoning
in recorded social interactions; real-time
interactive settings remain unevaluated. While the benchmark
covers diverse scenarios, its evaluation remains
bounded by the represented social and cultural
contexts. Future work could expand contextual and
cultural diversity, explore streaming and interactive
evaluation, and incorporate more fine-grained human
assessments of explanation quality.

blocks.en:
The taxonomy connects social observation to contextual response

blocks.en:

requirements determine its capability assignment, enabling diagnosis

blocks.en: Capability Definitions
blocks.zh: 能力定义

blocks.en: Perceptually Grounded Mentalizing
blocks.zh: 观念上的思想化

blocks.en:
This domain relates observable interaction structure to human states
and needs through cues about each person and the supplied context.
blocks.zh:
这个领域将可观测的互动结构与人类国家联系起来
并需要通过提示 每个人和提供的背景。

blocks.en:
Grounding identifies participants, observable behavior, and interaction
relations: who speaks, who is addressed, and whose gesture or action
is described. Speech, expression, gaze, and movement provide
cues specific to each person; turn structure and spatial context distinguish
speakers, addressees, and targets. Associating a cue with the correct
participant establishes what was observed. Explaining the person’s
underlying state instead belongs to Understanding.
blocks.zh:
确定参与者、可观察到的行为和互动
关系:谁说话,谁说话,谁的姿态或行动
说明。 发言、表达、凝视和行动
每个人特有的提示;转动结构和空间背景的区分
发言者、收件人和目标。 将提示与正确
与会者确定了观察到的情况。 解释当事人
相反,基础状态属于理解。

blocks.en:
Understanding concerns psychological states and their possible causes
or changes during an interaction. Theory of Mind motivates the
distinction between observed behavior and attributed mental
states [ 49 ] . Judgments integrate dialogue, behavior,
and context to interpret converging or conflicting cues.
The target is an interpretation of the person’s state supported
by observed cues within the supplied interaction.
blocks.zh:
了解心理状态及其可能的原因
或相互作用过程中的变化。 心灵理论激励着
被观察到的行为和被归咎于精神的区别
声明[49]。 判断结合了对话,行为,
和上下文解释趋同或相互冲突的提示。
目标是解释被支持者的状况
以在提供的互动中观察到的提示表示。

blocks.en:
Need identifies what a person wants to change, what support may be
relevant, and whether they would accept it. Requests, hesitation,
refusal, repeated difficulty, and affective reactions inform these
judgments. Distinguishing practical help, acknowledgment, or space requires
cues indicating what support the person wants. N thus distinguishes possible
support needs from willingness to receive help; T, S, and A address
when and how to respond.
blocks.zh:
需要说明一个人想要改变什么,可能是什么支持
以及他们是否会接受。 请求,犹豫,
拒绝、反复困难和反动反应为它们提供了信息
判决。 区分实际帮助、承认或空间需要
提示显示 人想要什么支持。 N 从而区分可能
接受帮助的意愿需要支助; T、S和A地址
何时以及如何回应。

blocks.en: Situated Empathic Responding
blocks.zh: 定位的情感反应

blocks.en:
This domain evaluates intervention opportunity, verbal content, and
behavioral form as distinct aspects of response appropriateness.
blocks.zh:
本领域评价干预机会、口头内容和
行为形式是反应适当性的不同方面。

blocks.en:
Timing judges whether to respond now, continue listening, wait,
or refrain. Conversational turn-taking motivates attention to ongoing
speech and participation [ 59 ] ; PsycheMME also
considers activity, urgency, pauses, and changes across the interaction.
Turn structure and current activity establish whether a pause offers
an appropriate intervention opportunity.
blocks.zh:
时间判断是否现在应答,继续听,等待,
或节奏。 对话性的转折促使人们注意正在进行的
言论和参与[59];PhyseMME 也
考虑活动、紧迫性、暂停和相互作用的变化。
转动结构和当前活动确定暂停提议是否
适当的干预机会。

blocks.en:
Response selects what to say and how to say it when a verbal
intervention is appropriate. Content, strategy, and tone should fit
the person’s state, need, and context, consistent with research on
matching support to stressful circumstances [ 14 ] .
Suitable responses include acknowledgment, validation, clarification,
advice, or a restrained reply. S evaluates the fit of response content,
strategy, and tone to the situation, complementing N’s support need
and T’s intervention opportunity.
blocks.zh:
回答选择说话和说话的方式
干预是适当的。 内容、战略和语气应当适合
个人的状况、需要和背景,与研究
匹配支持到压力环境 [14] 。
适当的反应包括承认、确认、澄清、
劝告,或责备, S评价反应内容是否合适,
战略,以及形势的基调,补充N的支持需要
以及T的干预机会。

blocks.en:
Action selects appropriate physical or nonverbal behavior, including
gaze, gesture, interpersonal distance, assistance, approach, retreat,
and handover. Judgments combine the person’s state and need with
physical and social context. Recognizing an action already performed
belongs to G; choosing a subsequent action belongs to A.
The evaluation target is the appropriateness of the behavioral choice.
blocks.zh:
动作选择适当的物理或非语言行为,包括:
凝视,姿态,人际距离,援助,接近,撤退,
和移交。 判决将个人的状态和需要与
物质和社会背景。 承认已经采取的行动
属于G;选择后续动作属于A.
评价的目标是行为选择的适当性。

blocks.en: Contextual and Normative Modulation
blocks.zh: 背景和规范模式

blocks.en:
Memory provides continuity across interactions; Risk constrains
otherwise feasible or helpful responses.
blocks.zh:
内存提供互动的连续性; 风险约束
在其他方面可行或有帮助的反应。

blocks.en:
Memory uses relevant supplied history to interpret the current person
and situation. Interaction memory includes prior events,
utterances, requests, refusals, and outcomes; profile memory includes individual preferences, habits, boundaries, and choices,
connecting to personalized multimodal reasoning [ 42 ] .
Available history establishes individual preferences and
constraints. These categories organize the historical information
supplied to Memory questions.
blocks.zh:
内存使用相关提供的历史来解释当前人物
和情况。 交互记忆包括以前的事件,
言论、请求、拒绝和结果;概况内存包括个人偏好、习惯、界限和选择,
连接到个性化的多式联运推理 [42].
现有历史确定了个人偏好,

blocks.en:
Risk addresses harm, consent, personal boundaries, and autonomy.
Embodied evaluation focused on safety motivates attention to action
consequences [ 69 ] ; PsycheMME also considers
expressed preferences and refusals. Constraints may require changing,
delaying, or abandoning an intervention. N identifies support needs; R checks the proposed intervention
against consent and other relevant constraints.

注重安全的良好评价促使人们关注行动
后果[69];PhyseMME也考虑
表示偏好和拒绝。 限制可能需要改变,

blocks.en:
Expressions, utterances, and actions may support multiple psychological
accounts. Valid interpretations fit the supplied situation; responses
require cues supporting their timing, content, and form. Requests and
refusals establish willingness to receive support, while relevant
history establishes individual preferences.

Question construction separates proposing a reference answer from

a question, candidate answer, applicable options, and supporting cues.

Knowledge guides all three agents in aligning questions with the target

coherence, alignment with the target capability, and agreement between
answers.

blocks.en: Iterative Question Refinement

blocks.en:
Critic feedback determines whether a candidate needs a clearer question
or a renewed examination of the cues. Ambiguous referents,
unsupported premises, and defects in answer options prompt question revision;
reasoning errors prompt another independent answer. Every revised
question is answered again without revealing the proposed reference.
Candidates that remain unresolved after two refinement rounds are
discarded.

或重新检查提示。 妄言的人们,

推理错误引发另一个独立答案. 每经修订
问题再次得到回答,但未透露提议的提法。

reference answer, textual descriptions of reference cues, and the

blocks.en:
Among 72 T single-choice questions, 15 are answered correctly
by all eight proprietary models and six are answered incorrectly by all.
The best Raw score from a single model is 48/72 (66.67%), whereas
selecting an existing correct answer with the reference yields
66/72 (91.67%; Table 24 ).
The oracle using reference answers bounds recoverable answer coverage.
For each question, each selected option ID casts one vote. Plurality selects the
option with the most votes. When r r options tie, expected answer credit is 1 / r 1/r if the correct option is among them and zero otherwise.
Across all 72 Timing questions, including three with tied highest
votes, expected plurality accuracy is 41.5/72 (57.64%) under uniform
tie breaking.

blocks.en: Question Answering Protocol
blocks.zh: 问答协议

blocks.en:
Five annotators independently answer 300 randomly sampled benchmark questions spanning all eight capabilities,
providing one response per annotator for each question (1,500 responses).
Answers are scored against the benchmark references. This experiment measures human answer accuracy.
blocks.zh:
5名注释员独立回答300个随机抽样的基准问题,涵盖所有8个能力,
为每个问题提供每个注释人一份答复(1,500份答复)。
答复的评分参照基准参考。 这个实验测量了人类的答案准确性.

blocks.zh: 汇总和报告

blocks.en: Appendix L Human-Judge Agreement
blocks.zh: 附录L 人类法官协定

blocks.en:
We measure Human-Judge Agreement through expert endorsement of the
presented Judge decisions. Five psychology experts independently
review 300 randomly sampled Judge cases spanning all eight capabilities, yielding 1,500
assessments.
Each expert examines the Judge’s labels and
justifications against the reference cues and records whether they
agree with the presented decision.
blocks.zh:
我们通过专家对《人权法官协定》的认可,衡量《人权法官协定》的执行情况。
提出法官裁决。 5位心理学专家独立
随机抽查法官案件300件,涉及所有8个能力,产生1 500件
评估。
每个专家审查法官的标签和
参照提示的理由和记录是否
同意所提出的决定。

blocks.en:
Experts endorse the Judge’s decisions in 1,352 assessments (90.13%).
The mean agreement rate across the eight capabilities is 89.79%.
Table 29 reports individual and pooled
agreement, and Table 30 reports
results by capability.

and episode bootstrap procedure.
